description: Keeps OpenCode agent sessions alive: auto-retries rate-limited, timed-out, overloaded or empty model turns with capped backoff, then gives up loudly instead of silently stalling. Plays distinct sounds for task completed, failure, and human-decision-needed

detail.description_zh: 保持 OpenCode 代理会话活跃：对受限速、超时、过载或空模型的请求自动重试，并使用有限的回退策略，然后在放弃时响亮提示而不是悄无声息地停滞。对任务完成、失败和需要人工决策时播放不同的声音
